title: Final Consonants and Audible Grammar
subtitle: When grammar is correct but listeners can’t hear it
description: English grammar is often carried by final consonant sounds. Spanish speakers tend to soften or drop these sounds. This sheet focuses on making grammar audible at B1 level.

categories.title: Past Tense Endings
categories.description: Past tense in English is often shown by a quiet final sound that must be heard.

categories.title: Plural and Third Person S
categories.description: Final S sounds show plurals and he or she in the present tense.

categories.title: Ending Sounds Change Meaning
categories.description: Final sounds change time and meaning. Missing them causes grammar mistakes.
